Search.title: Search
Search.body: Search across the whole workspace: contacts, documents, journal entries, items and more, grouped by kind and ranked. Every hit leads straight to the surface it belongs to; there is no separate detail view here. The query and filters live in the address, so a link to a result can be shared. Only what you may read appears.
